## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- 自读 + FULL OUTER JOIN omni metrics (with_omni 版本写端)
-- 从 ads_item_key_metrics_daily (上日分区) 作为基础, 补 omni 全链路指标
SELECT
    COALESCE(t.entrance, oi.scene, sg.entrance) as entrance,
    t.*, oi.ads_imp_cnt, oi.ads_clk_cnt, oi.ads_order_cnt, oi.ads_gmv_usd,
    oi.total_imp, oi.total_clk, oi.total_order, oi.total_gmv,
    oi.total_add_to_cart_cnt,
    sg.total_seller_gmv_usd,
    attr.item_name, attr.shop_name, attr.shop_gmv_tier, attr.stock,
    attr.hot_item_tag, attr.potential_item_tag, attr.new_item_tag
FROM ads_item_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live t  -- self read (上日分区)
FULL OUTER JOIN omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily oi
    ON t.item_id = oi.item_id AND t.shop_id <=> oi.shop_id
    AND t.grass_region = oi.grass_region AND t.grass_date = oi.grass_date
    AND t.entrance = oi.scene
FULL OUTER JOIN dws_omni_item_shop_entrance_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live sg
    ON COALESCE(t.item_id, oi.item_id) = sg.item_id
    AND COALESCE(t.shop_id, oi.shop_id) <=> sg.shop_id
    AND COALESCE(t.entrance, oi.scene) = sg.entrance
LEFT JOIN dim_omni_item_shop_attr_daily__reg_s0_live attr
    ON COALESCE(t.item_id, oi.item_id, sg.item_id) = attr.item_id
    AND COALESCE(t.shop_id, oi.shop_id, sg.shop_id) = attr.shop_id

-- UNION ALL 聚合到 union 表 (核心下游)

    ads_id, campaign_id, item_id, shop_id, ...
FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.ads_item_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}') AND grass_region in ('SG')

-- 关联商品维表 (物品新品标记, 用于 PCOC 分析)
LEFT JOIN mp_item.dim_item__reg_s0_live n
  ON b.grass_region = n.grass_region
 AND b.grass_date = n.grass_date
 AND b.item_id = n.item_id
WHERE n.status = 1
  AND CAST(n.create_datetime AS DATE) BETWEEN grass_date - INTERVAL '30' DAY AND grass_date
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. qq 版本生产逻辑 (写端, 8 地区)
```sql
with ads_base_info as (
    select *
    from mkplpaidads_search_ads.ads_advertise_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
    where grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
        and grass_region in ('ID','PH','SG','TH','TW','MY','VN', 'BR')
)
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mkplpaidads_search_ads.ads_item_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
PARTITION (grass_date=date'${ISO_YESTERDAY}', grass_region)
select
    entrance,
    null as plan_bucket_id, null as pricing_type, null as ads_id, null as campaign_id,
    item_id,
    max(shop_id) as shop_id,
    max(shop_level1_global_be_category) as shop_level1_global_be_category,
    ...,
    sum(revenue_usd) as revenue_usd, sum(advv_usd) as advv_usd,
    sum(direct_gmv_usd) as direct_gmv_usd, sum(broad_gmv_usd) as broad_gmv_usd,
    ...,
    case
        when sum(daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) is null or sum(broad_gmv_usd) is null then 'null'
        when nvl(sum(broad_gmv_usd), 0) = 0 then 'null'
        when sum(daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / sum(broad_gmv_usd) > 1.2 then 'overpcoc'
        when sum(daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / sum(broad_gmv_usd) > 0.8 then 'fulfillmentpcoc'
        else 'underpcoc'
    end as pcoc_tier,
    (CASE WHEN MAX(MOD(FLOOR(coalesce(ad_tag, 0) / POWER(2, 34)), 2)) = 1 THEN POWER(2, 34) ELSE 0 END)
    + (CASE WHEN MAX(MOD(FLOOR(coalesce(ad_tag, 0) / POWER(2, 50)), 2)) = 1 THEN POWER(2, 50) ELSE 0 END)
    + (CASE WHEN MAX(MOD(FLOOR(coalesce(ad_tag, 0) / POWER(2, 61)), 2)) = 1 THEN POWER(2, 61) ELSE 0 END) AS ad_tag,
    grass_region
from ads_base_info
group by item_id, entrance, grass_region, grass_date
```

### 2. with_omni 版本生产逻辑 (写端, 8 地区, 自读 + 多表 JOIN)
```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${SCHEMA}.ads_item_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
PARTITION (grass_date=date'${ISO_YESTERDAY}', grass_region='SG')
select
    COALESCE(t.entrance, oi.scene, sg.entrance) as entrance,
    t.plan_bucket_id, t.pricing_type, t.ads_id, t.campaign_id,
    COALESCE(t.item_id, oi.item_id, sg.item_id) as item_id,
    COALESCE(t.shop_id, oi.shop_id, sg.shop_id) as shop_id,
    -- 来自 t (self read): 广告相关指标 + tier 维度 + 出价/扣费 + 模型分
    t.revenue_usd, t.advv_usd, t.direct_gmv_usd, t.broad_gmv_usd,
    t.ads_imp, t.ads_clk, t.ads_direct_order, t.ads_broad_order,
    t.pcoc_tier, t.under_bidding_tier_1d, ...,
    -- 来自 oi (omni): 全链路流量指标 (含自然)
    oi.ads_imp_cnt, oi.ads_clk_cnt, oi.ads_order_cnt, oi.ads_gmv_usd,
    oi.total_imp, oi.total_clk, oi.total_order, oi.total_gmv,
    oi.total_add_to_cart_cnt,
    -- 来自 sg (seller gmv)
    sg.total_seller_gmv_usd,
    -- 来自 attr (item/shop 属性)
    attr.item_name, attr.shop_name,
    COALESCE(attr.shop_gmv_tier, t.shop_gmv_tier) as shop_gmv_tier,
    COALESCE(attr.hot_item_tag, t.hot_item_tag) as hot_item_tag,
    COALESCE(attr.potential_item_tag, t.potential_item_tag) as potential_item_tag,
    COALESCE(attr.new_item_tag, t.new_item_tag) as new_item_tag,
    COALESCE(attr.stock, t.stock) as stock
from (
    select * from ${SCHEMA}.ads_item_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
    where grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}') and grass_region = 'SG'
) t
full outer join (
    select grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id,
        case when common_feature in ('Daily Discover') then 'DD'
             when common_feature in ('You May Also Like') then 'YMAL'
             when common_feature in ('Cart Recommendation', 'Hot Deals Landing Recommendation', ...) then 'PP'
             when common_feature in ('Global Search', 'Image Search') then 'SEARCH'
             when common_feature in ('Games', 'Voucher Master') then 'GAME'
             when common_feature in ('Live Streaming', 'Livestream Game') then 'LIVESTREAM'
             when common_feature in ('Search Shop') then 'SHOP'
             when common_feature in ('Shop Game') then 'SHOP_GAME'
             when common_feature in ('From the Same Shop', 'Shop Main Browsing', ...) then 'IN_SHOP'
             else 'other'
        end as scene,
        sum(ads_imp_cnt) as ads_imp_cnt, sum(total_imp) as total_imp, ...
    from ${SCHEMA}.omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily
    where grass_region = 'SG' and grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
    group by 1,2,3,4,5
) oi on t.item_id = oi.item_id and t.shop_id <=> oi.shop_id
     and t.grass_region = oi.grass_region and t.grass_date = oi.grass_date
     and t.entrance = oi.scene
full outer join (
    select grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id, entrance,
        max(total_seller_gmv_usd) as total_seller_gmv_usd
    from ${SCHEMA}.dws_omni_item_shop_entrance_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
    where grass_region = 'SG' and grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
    group by 1,2,3,4,5
) sg on COALESCE(t.item_id, oi.item_id) = sg.item_id
     and COALESCE(t.shop_id, oi.shop_id) <=> sg.shop_id
     and COALESCE(t.entrance, oi.scene) = sg.entrance
left join (
    select grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id,
        max(item_name) as item_name, max(shop_name) as shop_name,
        max(shop_gmv_tier) as shop_gmv_tier,
        max(hot_item_tag) as hot_item_tag, max(potential_item_tag) as potential_item_tag,
        max(new_item_tag) as new_item_tag, max(stock) as stock
    from ${SCHEMA}.dim_omni_item_shop_attr_daily__reg_s0_live
    where grass_region = 'SG' and grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
    group by 1,2,3,4
) attr on COALESCE(t.item_id, oi.item_id, sg.item_id) = attr.item_id
     and COALESCE(t.shop_id, oi.shop_id, sg.shop_id) = attr.shop_id
```

### 4. PCOC 有效性分析 (arrive_pcoc, 手动分析)
```sql
WITH table_base AS (
    SELECT
        grass_region, grass_date, item_id,
        CASE
            WHEN ads_broad_order >= 5
                 AND daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk / broad_gmv_usd >= 0.8
                 AND daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk / broad_gmv_usd <= 1.2
            THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0
        END AS valid_pcoc_rev_5o,
        CASE
            WHEN daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk / broad_gmv_usd >= 0.8
                 AND daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk / broad_gmv_usd <= 1.2
            THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0
        END AS valid_pcoc_rev_all,
        revenue_usd,
        CASE WHEN ads_broad_order >= 5 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END AS revenue_usd_5o,
        daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk, broad_gmv_usd
    FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.ads_item_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE '2026-03-22'
      AND grass_region = 'ID'
      AND entrance IN ('Search')
),
new_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT grass_region, grass_date, item_id
    FROM mp_item.dim_item__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region IN ('ID', 'BR', 'PH', 'TH', 'MY', 'VN', 'SG', 'TW')
      AND grass_date = DATE '2026-03-22'
      AND CAST(create_datetime AS DATE) BETWEEN grass_date - INTERVAL '30' DAY AND grass_date
      AND status = 1
),
table_with_flag AS (
    SELECT b.*,
        CASE WHEN n.item_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'new_item' ELSE 'non_new_item' END AS item_bucket
    FROM table_base b
    LEFT JOIN new_items n
        ON b.grass_region = n.grass_region AND b.grass_date = n.grass_date AND b.item_id = n.item_id
)
SELECT
    grass_region, grass_date, item_bucket,
    SUM(daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / NULLIF(SUM(broad_gmv_usd), 0) AS daily_pgmv_pcoc,
    SUM(valid_pcoc_rev_5o) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_usd_5o), 0) AS valid_pcoc_rev_ratio_5o,
    SUM(valid_pcoc_rev_all) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_usd), 0) AS valid_pcoc_rev_ratio_all
FROM table_with_flag
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
```

### 生产逻辑概要

- **qq 版本**: 从 `ads_advertise_key_metrics_daily` (广告粒度) 按 `item_id, entrance, grass_region, grass_date` 聚合。SUM 累加指标, MAX/MIN 取非累加维度值, CASE-WHEN 计算 pcoc_tier 和 ad_tag
- **with_omni 版本**: 从自身 (上日分区) 读入广告指标, FULL OUTER JOIN `omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily` 补全链路流量 (ads_imp_cnt, total_imp, total_add_to_cart_cnt 等), FULL OUTER JOIN `dws_omni_item_shop_entrance_metrics_daily` 补卖家 GMV, LEFT JOIN `dim_omni_item_shop_attr_daily` 补商品/店铺属性名称和标签
- **分区写入策略**: `PARTITION (grass_date=date'${ISO_YESTERDAY}', grass_region)`, 每日按地区并行写入

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

| Derived Field | Formula | Source |
|---------------|---------|--------|
| pcoc_tier | `CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN ratio > 1.2 THEN 'overpcoc' WHEN ratio > 0.8 THEN 'fulfillmentpcoc' ELSE 'underpcoc' END` (ratio = daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk / broad_gmv_usd) | ads_item_metrics (write, both qq and with_omni) |
| ad_tag (qq version) | `(bit34_test * 2^34) + (bit50_test * 2^50) + (bit61_test * 2^61)` | ads_item_metrics_qq (write) |
| ad_tag (qq_with_omni) | `(bit34 *2^34) + (bit50 *2^50) + (bit56 *2^56) + (bit57 *2^57) + (bit61 *2^61)` | ads_item_metrics_qq_with_omni (write, 5 bits) |
| entrance (from omni) | `CASE WHEN common_feature='Daily Discover' THEN 'DD' WHEN common_feature='You May Also Like' THEN 'YMAL' WHEN ... IN ('Cart Recommendation',...) THEN 'PP' WHEN ... IN ('Global Search','Image Search') THEN 'SEARCH' WHEN ... IN ('Games','Voucher Master') THEN 'GAME' WHEN ... IN ('Live Streaming','Livestream Game') THEN 'LIVESTREAM' END` | omni_core_key_metrics_merge (with_omni 写端) |
| hit_budget_tier | `CASE WHEN sum(revenue_usd) > 0.9 * max(valid_budget_campaign) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END` | discovery item_union_id |
| valid_pcoc_rev_5o | `CASE WHEN ads_broad_order >= 5 AND ratio in [0.8,1.2] THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END` | arrive_pcoc |
| daily_pgmv_pcoc | `daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk / broad_gmv_usd` | arrive_pcoc |
